text: @vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 是适用于 DSH Web 客户端的侧栏插件，会在工作区列表顶部展示跨工作区的置顶会话。它通过客户端界面扩展将分组挂载到原生侧栏列表，并读取 DSH 会话与工作区状态。用户可以搜索置顶会话、查看所属工作区和运行状态、折叠分组，并从行内打开、取消置顶、归档、重命名或分叉会话；设置页还可关闭该分组。适合需要在多个工作区间快速找回常用会话的用户。需要 DSH Web 客户端，不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions adds a pinned-session group to the DSH Web sidebar across workspaces. Users can search the list, view status, and open, unpin, archive, rename, or fork sessions. A General settings switch hides the group. Requires DSH Web; no extra key or account.
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 的功能「跨工作区置顶分组」：在侧栏工作区列表上方集中列出置顶会话，并显示会话所属工作区。用户点击分组标题可折叠或展开。
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 的功能「搜索置顶会话」：打开分组内的搜索框后输入关键词，列表即时筛选置顶会话并显示匹配数量。
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 的功能「管理会话」：每条置顶会话行可打开会话，并提供取消置顶、归档、重命名、分叉及复制会话标识等操作；具体菜单按当前可用服务显示。
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 的功能「置顶分组开关」：在设置的 General 项中提供开关，用户可隐藏或重新显示侧栏置顶分组；选择会保存在浏览器本地存储中。
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 的功能「会话状态与任务提示」：置顶行显示会话运行或待处理状态；若主机提供 Schedule 服务，还可为拥有活动计划任务的会话显示时钟标记。
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions 使用前须知：分组通过查找侧栏的 sidebar.workspaces DOM 锚点挂载；若 DSH 后续版本移除该锚点，置顶分组将不显示。

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · What it does：DSH already pins sessions (hover a row → pin glyph, or right-click → 「置顶会话」),
but the result is only a re-order **inside that session's own workspace group**: a
pinned session still scrolls away when you switch workspaces, collapse groups, or
drown in a long list.

This plugin gives the pinned set its own group, above the Workspace browser:

```
插件
自动化任务
工作区                        ← the native section header
置顶  1  dsh-pinned-sessions v0.7.0  🔍   ← this plugin, inside the list

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · What it does：With the search open (the count becomes `matched/total`):

```
置顶  1/3  dsh-pinned-sessions v0.7.0  ✕
   [ 搜索置顶会话              ]
   插件笔记：dsh-cost-…   4 小时前
```

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · What it does：- rows are drawn with the **native session-row metrics** (32px rows, 14px titles,
  10px meta, the same hover wash and hover-revealed actions), so the group is
  visually indistinguishable from a workspace group;
- the group is mounted **inside the native list's own scroll container**, as its
  first item: it sits under the 「工作区」 header with the same scrollbar as the
  groups below, never squeezes them, and steps aside while the list shows search
  results;
- each row shows **which workspace it belongs to** (`默认工作区`) and carries the
  session's own status dot from the **same store the native rows read**
  (`uiSession.sessionStatus`): running is the native rotating arc, finished-but-unopened
  is a green dot, and a pending approval / plan review / question is an amber dot whose
  compact label (「待审批」) replaces the timestamp; title, workspace and time also ride
  the row tooltip;
- an idle row whose session owns **active scheduled tasks** shows the native **clock
  mark** in the leading 16px cell — the same `IconClockOutlineRegular` the row further
  down the sidebar shows. That cell is exclusive: a live run, a pending interaction or

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · What it does：It owns **no new state**: pinning is the Host capability the native Workspace
browser already ships (`dsh-api-workspace-controller` → `workspaces.pinSession` /
`unpinSession`, persisted in the `workspace` storage unit), so the sidebar and the
group always agree — pin with either one and the other updates immediately.

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · How it is mounted：The sidebar's browsing region between the global panel rows and the foot is
declared as **one `single` slot** (`sidebar.workspaces`) owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`, and it exposes no "extra group" seat:

| seat | owner | what it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist` (list) | ui-sidebar | the global panel rows (插件, 自动化任务, …) — a row is a button, not a group |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (single) | ui-workspace | the whole browsing region: header, search, tree, menus |

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · How it is mounted：Shadowing `sidebar.workspaces` would mean reimplementing the entire browser
(search, flat/grouped views, drag ordering, menus, hover cards, archive flow), so
instead this plugin mounts **next to the renderer's own outlet anchor**
(`div[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]`, `display: contents`) as its previous
sibling inside the region, and portals the group into that host node:
@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Feedback：Bugs and ideas: [Issues](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-pinned-sessions/issues).

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions
```

The package is dual-face (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`): the Loader row
brings up the no-op Host half, and the browser half arrives through
`exports["./client"]`.

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · 2) activate the row in your own patch layer (hot: the loader watches it)：Then **reload the Web UI** (⌘R / F5). The boot graph is rebuilt per page load, so
an edited `lib/client.js` shows up on the next reload — no application restart.
Do **not** also add `@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions` to `dsh.profile.bundles` at the
same time: `insert` is append-only and never de-duplicates ids, so the plugin
would be mounted twice and its slot registrations would collide. (Appending that
row to a patch file that still holds the template's bare `[]` produces invalid
YAML and is silently ignored — `[]` plus a sequence is two documents in one file.)

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Develop：`lib/client.js` is the browser bundle, written by hand in the same
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the build emits — plain JS
with `react.createElement`, no build step, no JSX. `apply(ctx)` registers exactly
one entry:

| registration | slot | id |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sidebar group (portals into the sidebar) | `shell.overlay` (list) | `pinned-sessions-section` |

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Develop：Client services it injects: `slots`, `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`,
`uiSession`, `locale`. It reads the three stores (`sessions.list`,
`workspaces.list`, `uiSession.sessionStatus`) through `useSyncExternalStore` and
never writes to them directly.

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Develop：The scheduled-task clock does **not** go through a slot: the
`sidebar.session.row.leading` seat is declared by ui-workspace's entry, the slot
runtime rejects a `renderSlot` the caller did not declare, and declaring an
already-declared seat throws `slot "…" is already declared`. So the group reads the
same Host catalog (`schedule/catalog()`) itself — one read for the whole group,
refreshed on `schedule/changed` and connection reset, released when the last row
unmounts. `remote` is deliberately **not** a required inject: a composition without
ui-schedule still loads the group, it just has no clock.

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Checks：Registers the bundle against a fake `window.__ModuleLoader__`, materializes the
factory with stub `require`, runs `apply()` against a fake Client Context and
renders the group with a hook shim — asserting the entry id, the dictionaries'
key parity, the anchor selector, pin order, the count, the running dot, the
unpin toggle (and that it does not also open the row), collapse, the empty hint,
the archived note, subagent filtering, the English copy, and the npm chip (its
text, its `href`, `target`/`rel`, and that clicking it does not toggle the group).

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Checks：The scheduled-task mark has its own region: the clock glyph in the 16px leading
cell, its localized label, the row tooltip, no mark at a count of 0, and the three
states that **outrank** it (running, pending approval, unread completion). The
source itself is covered too — one read per subscription, active-only counting,
one re-read per `schedule/changed` and per connection reset, release on the last
unsubscribe, and no mark after a rejected or refused read.

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Checks：Because a client bundle cannot read its own manifest, `lib/client.js` repeats the
package name and version (`PACKAGE_NAME` / `PACKAGE_VERSION`). The chip checks
compare them against `package.json`, so a version bump that forgets the bundle
fails the suite instead of shipping a stale chip.

The DOM-mounting half needs a real sidebar, so it is covered by the Playwright
pass recorded in [VERIFY.md](VERIFY.md).

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Layout：```
lib/index.js      Host half — no-op; exists so the Loader row resolves and the
                  client-modules scan can find the package
lib/client.js     Browser half — the whole feature
cordis.patch.yml  Bundle patch: one row, id === package name

@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions README · Known boundaries：- The group lists **pinned, non-archived** sessions; archived pins are summarised
  in a note instead of listed (matching the native archive filter).
- Subagent sessions (`origin: "subagent"`) never appear.
- Order is the native pin order (newest pin first); this plugin adds no custom
  sorting, and the group is a flat list rather than one sub-group per workspace.
- Mounting is anchor-based, not a slot: a future sidebar rewrite that removes
  `div[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]` would hide the group.
- The clock mark depends on the Host Schedule face (`remote.schedule.catalog`):
  without ui-schedule, or when that read is refused or fails, the row simply has no
  mark — it never shows a stale one and never throws.
